  • Method Details

    • checkAndModifyCertRequest

      default CheckAndModifyResult checkAndModifyCertRequest(byte[] transactionID, String requesterDn, byte[] certTemplate, String requestedSubjectDn, byte[] pkiMessage)
      check and optionally modify a CRMF certificate request that was received in a CMP ir, cr or kur message.
      Parameters:
      transactionID - the transactionID of the CMP request message. The transactionID can be used to correlate calls of checkAndModifyCertRequest(byte[], String, byte[], String, byte[]) and learnEnrollmentResult(byte[], byte[], String, String, String).
      requesterDn - Distinguished Name (DN) of the CMP requester. This is the subject of the first certificate in the extraCerts field of the CMP request or the sender extracted from the PKI message header. If neither signature-based protection was used nor the sender field was set the requesterDn is null. The DN is an X500 name formatted as string according to the BouncyCastle library defaults.
      certTemplate - the ASN.1 DER-encoded CertTemplate of the certificate request as received from the requester. Note that it may indicate central key generation, optionally specifying key parameters.
      requestedSubjectDn - subject DN extracted from the CertTemplate of the request or null if subject was not present. The DN is an X500 name formatted as string according to the BouncyCastle library defaults. This parameter is provided for convenience.
      pkiMessage - the ASN.1 DER-encoded CMP ir, cr or kur message
      Returns:
      result of validation check

    • checkP10CertRequest

      default boolean checkP10CertRequest(byte[] transactionID, String requesterDn, byte[] pkcs10CertRequest, String requestedSubjectDn, byte[] pkiMessage)
      check PKCS#10 certificate request that was received in CMP p10cr message. Note that such certificate request cannot be modified because it is self-signed by the requester.
      Parameters:
      transactionID - the transactionID of the CMP request message. The transactionID can be used to correlate calls of checkP10CertRequest(byte[], String, byte[], String, byte[]) and learnEnrollmentResult(byte[], byte[], String, String, String).
      requesterDn - Distinguished Name (DN) of the CMP requester. This is the subject of the first certificate in the extraCerts field of the CMP request or the sender extracted from the PKI message header. If neither signature-based protection was used nor the sender field was set the requesterDn is null. The DN is an X500 name formatted as string according to the BouncyCastle library defaults.
      pkcs10CertRequest - the ASN.1 DER-encoded PKCS#10 certificate request as received from a requester in a p10cr request.
      requestedSubjectDn - subject DN extracted from the CertificationRequestInfo of the pkcs10CertRequest. The DN is an X500 name formatted as string according to the BouncyCastle library defaults. This parameter is provided for convenience.
      pkiMessage - the ASN.1 DER-encoded CMP p10cr message
      Returns:
      true if the called component agrees to accepting the request.

    • checkRevocationRequest

      default boolean checkRevocationRequest(byte[] transactionID, String senderDN, String serialNumber, String issuerDN, byte[] pkiMessage)
      check a revocation request that was received in a CMP rr message.
      Parameters:
      transactionID - the transactionID of the CMP request message.
      senderDN - the sender of the CMP rr message, or null if not available in the request.
      serialNumber - string representation of the serial number of the certificate to revoke, or null if not available in the request.
      issuerDN - the issuer Distinguished Name of the certificate to revoke, or null if not available in the request.
      pkiMessage - the ASN.1 DER-encoded CMP rr message
      Returns:
      true if the called component agrees to accepting the request.

    • learnEnrollmentResult

      default boolean learnEnrollmentResult(byte[] transactionID, byte[] certificate, String serialNumber, String subjectDN, String issuerDN)
      learn the enrollment of a new certificate. May respond false in case of internal processing error.
      Parameters:
      transactionID - the transactionID of the CMP request/response message. The transactionID can be used to correlate calls of checkAndModifyCertRequest(byte[], String, byte[], String, byte[]) or checkP10CertRequest(byte[], String, byte[], String, byte[]) and learnEnrollmentResult(byte[], byte[], String, String, String).
      certificate - the new certificate, which is assumed to be ASN.1 DER encoded, as returned by the CA.
      serialNumber - string representation of the certificate serial number. In case of enrollment failure, null is given. This parameter is provided for convenience.
      subjectDN - the subject Distinguished Name extracted from the certificate or from the certificate request in case of enrollment failure. This parameter is provided for convenience.
      issuerDN - the issuer Distinguished Name extracted from the certificate. In case of enrollment failure, null is given. This parameter is provided for convenience.
      Returns:
      true on success, false triggers an error response message.
